call.hello.hello_again.back: Hello? Can you hear me or not?
call.hello.hello_again.note: AI check: 'Boleh dengar saya tak?' (can you hear me?) instead of 'Hi?'; same choice as the earlier batches.

call.speech.im_here.back: Yes, I'm here, I can hear you. Go ahead.
call.speech.im_here.note: Fixed per back-translation note. needs_fix: 'Ya, saya dengar. Sila cakap' lost 'I'm here'. Meaning should be: 'Yes, I'm here, I can hear you. Go ahead.', e.g. 'Ya, saya ada, saya dengar. Sila cakap.'

call.speech.still_there.back: Hello? Are you still on the line?

call.speech.think_about_it.back: I have to think about it first.

call.speech.wait_one_more.back: Eh, wait a moment, I have one more question.
call.speech.wait_one_more.note: Fixed per back-translation note. needs_fix: 'Oh ya, saya ada satu soalan lagi' means 'Oh yes, I have one more question' and lost 'wait'. This line stops the caller from hanging up, so it should mean 'Oh, wait, I have one more question', e.g. 'Eh, kejap, saya ada satu soalan lagi.'

call.speech.no_wait.back: «wait a moment», «wait a moment (formal)», «wait a sec», «let me check», «let me check» (informal), «let me have a look», «a moment, okay»
call.speech.no_wait.note: Fixed per back-translation note. needs_fix: only saya/neutral forms are listed ('biar saya semak'); the friend forms with aku ('biar aku semak', 'biar aku tengok') and 'I'll have a look / I'll find out' ('saya tengok', 'nanti saya cari tahu') are missing, so the AI could say them unchecked. Meaning should be: banned stalling phrases for a friend and a stranger; add «biar aku semak», «biar saya tengok», «jap ya».

call.speech.unavailable.back: The number you dialed cannot be reached at this time. Please try again later.

call.speech.preview.back: Hello? / Oh, a package? Sure, just leave it at the front door, thank you very much. / All right, thank you, see you again.
call.speech.preview.note: AI check: last line adds 'terima kasih' (thanks) to 'Okay, bye'; harmless.

call.speech.closing.back: Farewells: see you again, goodbye, I'll hang up first, I'll call back later, take care, bye, bye-bye, we'll chat again later. Wrap-ups: that's all, I have a bit of work, we'll continue later, I don't want to disturb you any more. Ends: Thank you very much for the help just now, see you again. / All right, that's all for today, see you again. / It's all right, I'm not interested, bye. Not ends: Yesterday he only said see you again without a date, that's why I'm asking. / Don't say bye yet, I still have one question about the bill. / We will indeed meet again next week, but finish this first.
call.speech.closing.note: Fixed per back-translation note. needs_fix: 'selamat malam' is also the normal greeting after dark ('good evening'), so a caller who just says 'Selamat malam' to open could be read as ending the call; the translator already left out 'Assalamualaikum' for the same reason. Meaning should be: only real goodbyes in farewells, so remove 'selamat malam' and change ends example 2 so it ends with another farewell (e.g. 'jumpa lagi'). | Translator note: 'Assalamualaikum' left out on purpose: it is a greeting as often as a goodbye.

console.g_basics_d.back: A few things that the AI needs before it can answer your phone.

console.f_language_h.back: The language the AI uses when talking with callers.

console.f_notify_lang_h.back: The language for the notifications and summaries you read. It does not change the language the AI uses with callers.

console.f_simlang_h.back: Only for phones with a SIM from another country: calls to that SIM start in the language chosen here. Needs phone app 1.0 and above.

console.sl_empty.back: No setting: every call starts in the language above.

console.f_owner_h.back: The name callers use for you. The AI uses it when mentioning you.

console.f_owner_aliases.back: Other names that callers use for you

console.f_owner_aliases_h.back: An English name, a pseudonym and so on. One per line, up to 10. The AI knows they mean you.

console.style_assistant_d.back: Tells that it is your AI assistant and takes a message.

console.style_persona_d.back: Answers as if it were you, without agreeing to anything on your behalf.

console.f_key_link.back: Get a key at Google AI Studio

console.f_model_h.back: The model that the AI uses to talk. You rarely need to change it.

console.f_voice_h.back: The preview plays three sample lines in the language chosen above.

console.f_enabled_h.back: Off: calls are picked up and ended immediately. To let the phone ring as usual, use "Switch to normal phone" on the System page or in the phone app.

console.f_ring_h.back: Rings for a moment before answering, like a real person. 0 = immediately.

console.f_normal_max.back: Time limit of a normal call

console.f_normal_max_h.back: 3 to 30. Shortly before the time limit, the AI ends the conversation politely and puts down the phone.

console.f_prewarm.back: Prepare the AI while the phone rings

console.f_prewarm_h.back: Recommended: the AI talks as soon as the call is picked up. Off: callers wait 1 to 3 seconds.

console.f_unknown_h.back: On: callers without a caller ID are handled by the AI as usual. Off: they hear a brief "cannot be reached" announcement and the call ends.

console.f_barge_h.back: The AI stops and listens when the caller speaks. Not all phones support this; Bageo checks it by itself.

console.f_vad.back: Let Gemini determine when the caller has finished speaking

console.f_vad_h.back: Recommended. Off: determined by the strength of the voice only.

console.f_reply_lang_h.back: When the caller speaks in another language, the AI switches to that language.

console.f_status_h.back: A note about the current situation, such as where the courier should leave the parcel. The AI mentions it only when it is relevant to the call.

console.f_status_ph.back: e.g. Deliveries: please leave the parcel at the front counter.

console.f_amb_h.back: Adds a soft room sound behind the AI's voice so that it sounds like a real person answering.

console.g_spam_d.back: What the AI does when the caller is clearly selling something or trying to cheat.

console.f_stall_h.back: The AI pretends to be interested and keeps asking for details to delay their time. It gives out no data at all and agrees to nothing. Off: it rejects and puts down the phone.

console.f_stall_max_h.back: 3 to 30. Longer calls use more of your Gemini quota.

console.f_stall_model_h.back: Empty = the same model as normal calls.

console.g_prompt_d.back: A few short answers help the AI sound like you. All are optional.

console.f_prompt_ph.back: Empty: the built-in prompt is used

console.f_prompt_h.back: If filled in, it replaces the speaking style and local habits. Each answering style keeps its own prompt; write {owner} for your name.

console.p_builtin_h.back: For the saved language, answering style and name. Save first if you have just changed them.

console.p_replace_body.back: The editor already has text. It will be replaced with the built-in prompt.

console.f_knowledge.back: Notes the AI may answer from

console.f_knowledge_ph.back: e.g. Parcels: leave at the front counter. Opening hours: Monday to Friday, 9 to 6.

console.f_knowledge_h.back: Information callers may ask about, one per line. The AI must not invent things that are not written here.

console.g_blocked_d.back: Played when a call from the blacklist or a hidden number is rejected. Manage the blacklist in "Acquaintances".

console.b_help.back: End a number with * to put every number with the same prefix into the blacklist, e.g. 0800* (at least 3 digits, excluding leading zeros).

console.reject_decline.back: End while ringing (the call is not connected)

console.reject_announce.back: Answer, play "cannot be reached", then end

console.f_reject_voice_h.back: The announcement is spoken in the language chosen above.

console.f_notify_on_h.back: Off: no messages are sent to the notification channels.

console.mcp_on_h.back: Works only when this is turned on and the Token below is set. Its address is the web console address plus /mcp.

console.hint_telegram.back: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token. Chat ID: @userinfobot tells you your ID; for a group use the group ID and put the bot into it. Send a message to the bot once so that it is allowed to write to you.

console.hint_discord.back: Notifications: fill in the Webhook URL (channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy Webhook URL) or the bot token together with the channel ID; one of them is sufficient. To receive them through a private message, enter your own ID in the channel ID field. Chat commands: fill in the bot token and the channel ID, and turn on Message Content Intent for the bot.

console.hint_slack.back: Notifications: copy the Incoming Webhook URL (including Mattermost) or fill in the bot token together with the channel ID; one of them is sufficient. Chat commands (Slack only): turn on Socket Mode, then fill in the bot token (xoxb-), the application-level token (xapp-) and the channel ID.

console.hint_line.back: LINE Developers console → your Messaging API channel: issue a channel access token and copy your user ID (starts with U). Add the bot as a friend first. LINE Notify was discontinued in 2025; this replaces it.

console.hint_ntfy.back: Choose a topic name that is hard to guess and subscribe in the ntfy app. Leave the server empty for ntfy.sh. A token is only needed for protected topics.

console.hint_gotify.back: In Gotify: Apps → Create application, then copy its token. The server URL is the address of your Gotify server.

console.hint_bark.back: Open the Bark app on your iPhone and copy the device key from the sample URL. Leave the server empty to use the public server.

console.hint_pushover.back: Create an application at pushover.net to get the API token. Your user key is on the Pushover dashboard.

console.hint_wecom.back: In the WeCom group: add a group bot, then copy its webhook URL.

console.hint_dingtalk.back: Group settings → Bot → add a custom bot and copy the webhook URL. If you chose "Sign" as the security setting, paste the secret (starts with SEC).

console.hint_feishu.back: Group settings → Bot → Add bot → Custom bot, then copy the webhook URL. Do not turn on signature verification.

console.hint_serverchan.back: Copy your SendKey from the ServerChan website.

console.hint_matrix.back: Your homeserver (e.g. https://matrix.org), the access token of the sending account, and the ID of a room that the account has joined (starts with !).

console.hint_gmail.back: Your Gmail address and an application password (Google Account → Security → 2-Step Verification → Application passwords). Not your usual password.

console.hint_apprise.back: The notification URL of your Apprise API server, e.g. http://host:8000/notify/KEY. A tag limits which services receive the message.

console.hint_webhook.back: Any URL that accepts a JSON POST with event, title, body and data. Useful for n8n, Home Assistant or your own scripts.

console.hint_teams.back: In Teams: channel menu … → Workflows → "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received", complete the steps and copy the URL that is given. The old Office 365 connectors have been discontinued.

console.hint_googlechat.back: In Google Chat: open the space → Apps & integrations → Webhooks → Add webhook, then copy its URL. Requires a Google Workspace account.

console.hint_rocketchat.back: Administration → Workspace → Integrations → New → Incoming: turn it on, choose the channel and copy the webhook URL.

console.hint_zulip.back: Personal settings → Bots → Add a new bot (Incoming webhook or Generic) and enter the email and API key as email:key. Target: channel > topic (e.g. calls > phone), or one or more emails for a direct message.

console.hint_webex.back: Create a bot at developer.webex.com and copy its access token. Add the bot to a room and enter the room ID, or enter someone's email.

console.hint_nextcloud.back: Your Nextcloud address, user name and application password (Settings → Security) written as user:password, and the conversation token: the last part of the conversation link.

console.hint_synology.back: In Synology Chat: Integration → Incoming Webhooks → Create, then copy the webhook URL. On your own network, the http:// address on port 5000 avoids certificate errors.

console.hint_signal.back: Requires your own signal-cli-rest-api server with a registered number. Enter the server address, the registered number in international format (+…) and the recipients: numbers or group IDs, separated with commas.

console.hint_pushbullet.back: pushbullet.com → Settings → Account → Create Access Token. Leave the target empty to send to all your devices, or enter a device ID or email.

console.hint_pushplus.back: Log in at pushplus.plus and copy your token. A group code sends to that group; empty sends to you only.

console.hint_pushdeer.back: Open the PushDeer app, add a key and copy it. Leave the server empty to use the public server.

console.hint_wxpusher.back: Simplest: a simple push token (SPT_…) from the WxPusher website, with no target. Or your app's appToken (AT_…) with user IDs (UID_…) or topic IDs, separated by commas.

console.hint_chanify.back: In the Chanify app, create a token for this sender and copy it. Leave the server empty to use the public server.

console.hint_smtp.back: Any mail server with TLS: smtp://you@example.com@smtp.example.com:587 (STARTTLS) or smtps://…:465. The login account is also the sender. Use an application password if your provider offers it.

console.hint_homeassistant.back: Your Home Assistant address, a long-term access token (Profile → Security) and the notification service, e.g. mobile_app_pixel_9 (listed under Developer tools → Actions).

console.hint_ifttt.back: ifttt.com/maker_webhooks → Documentation shows your key. Create an applet "If Webhooks: Receive a web request" with the same event name; value1 is the title and value2 is the message.

console.f_public_url_h.back: Links in notifications use this address. Empty = the grey address shown; with Docker, or for access from outside the home, type your own address.

console.use_this_url.back: Use the address of this page: {url}

console.g_summary_d.back: After every call, the AI writes a short summary. Normally nothing needs to be set here.

console.f_sum_base_h.back: Any OpenAI-compatible service can be used, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1.

console.f_sum_provider_h.back: Uses your Gemini key by default. To use another service, choose "Another service".

console.f_cal_suggest_h.back: When a call settles a date (delivery, appointment), the summary comes with an "add to calendar" link.

console.f_appt_mode_h.back: When a caller wants to set a time, the AI does not agree straight away; it says it will check first and inform them again. You then press Receive or Reject under "Needs to be done" on the Calls page, or in the notification.

console.f_appt_sms_h.back: After you make a decision, the phone that answered the call sends an SMS to the caller (mobile numbers only). Off: the AI phones them again.

console.f_appt_reply_h.back: Automatic: an SMS to a mobile number, an AI second call to a landline. Hidden numbers and numbers that cannot be contacted again (abroad, toll-free and so on) get no reply.

console.f_think_h.back: Only for models with "thinking" in their name. Low answers the fastest.

console.ph_none.back: Connect the phone with a USB data cable, turn on USB debugging and open the app.

console.ph_unauth.back: Waiting for permission: unlock the phone and accept the prompt "Allow USB debugging?".

console.ph_offline.back: Offline: unplug the cable and connect it again.

console.ph_noapp.back: The Bageo app is not yet installed on this phone.

console.ph_link_ok.back: The USB link is active and the app has been installed

console.ph_link_bad.back: The USB link is not ready yet. Wait a few seconds.

console.usb_off.back: The USB helper is switched off

console.usb_off_d.back: Phones connect to Bageo through the network.

console.usb_noadb_d.back: Phones on USB cannot be set up automatically. Install Android platform-tools or set ADB_BIN.

console.chk_key_bad.back: Enter your key so that the AI can talk.

console.chk_owner_bad.back: Tell the AI how callers address you.

console.chk_prompt_bad.back: Answer a few questions in "About you" so that the AI sounds more like you.

console.chk_phone_bad.back: No phone is connected now. See "Phones" on this page.

console.chk_notify_bad.back: Add a notification channel to receive call summaries on your phone.

console.chk_summary_bad.back: Requires a Gemini key or another summary service.

console.chk_ai_off.back: AI answering is currently switched off

console.chk_all.back: Everything is ready. Call your phone's number to try it.

console.ev_hello_reattach.back: Phone connected again during the call

console.ev_vm_end_hangup.back: Caller put down the phone while leaving a message

console.ev_vm_no_reply.back: Caller does not want a reply

console.ev_vm_confirm_timeout.back: No answer about how to reply

console.ev_vm_contact_readback_timeout.back: No answer when the contact information was read out again

console.ev_vm_contact_rejected.back: Caller said the contact information is wrong

console.ev_vm_reply_phone_confirmed.back: Caller asked for a second call

console.ev_gemini_zero_delivery_to_voice.back: AI had no sound, went into voicemail

console.ev_gemini_delivery_fail_to_voice.back: AI audio failed to play, went into voicemail

console.ev_call_waiting_rejected.back: Came in during another call, rejected because busy

console.ev_ivr_hangup.back: Recording or voice menu: call ended

console.nf_webex_token.note: fixed: keeps the service's field name

console.nf_homeassistant_token.note: fixed: keeps the service's field name

console.err_sms_not_retryable.back: This SMS cannot be sent again: the appointment has not been decided, or the SMS has already been sent.

console.err_no_calendar.back: This call has no calendar suggestion.

console.err_no_audio.back: This call has no recording of that type.

console.err_open_failed.back: The recording could not be opened.

console.err_unknown_background.back: This background sound is not available.

console.err_background_missing.back: The sound file for this background is missing.

console.err_preview_failed.back: The sample could not be made. Check the Gemini API key and try again.

console.err_bad_request.back: Bageo does not understand this request.

console.err_save_failed.back: The settings could not be written to the disk.

console.err_fulfill_failed.back: The task could not be carried out.

console.err_unknown_channel.back: Bageo does not recognize this notification service.

console.err_bad_url.back: "{field}" must begin with http:// or https://.

console.err_auth_failed.back: The service rejected the token or password.

console.err_service_not_found.back: The service does not recognize this address or token.

console.err_http_error.back: The service answered with an error.

console.err_service_error.back: The service reported a problem with the message.

console.err_room_encrypted.back: This room is encrypted, and Bageo cannot read encrypted rooms. Use a room without encryption.

console.err_blocked_address.back: Bageo will not send to this address. Enter the address of your own notification service.

console.err_network_error.back: The service could not be contacted.

console.f_mdns_name_h.back: Devices in the same network can open the web console at http://name.local. Letters, digits and hyphens only. Empty = off.

console.cu_qr_h.back: Scan the code with your phone camera to open the web console there.

console.cu_local.back: Only this computer can open this address.

console.cu_qr_alt.back: QR code of the web console address

console.a2hs_title.back: Add this page to your home screen. Next time, just tap its icon.

console.a2hs_ios.back: iPhone and iPad: Share → Add to Home Screen (Safari).

console.a2hs_android.back: Android: Chrome menu ⋮ → Add to home screen.

console.a2hs_desktop.back: Computer: the install icon to the right of the address bar (Chrome, Edge).

console.cu_ip.back: Phones that cannot open .local addresses (some older Android phones) use:

console.ph_mode_normal.back: Normal phone: calls ring, the AI does not answer

console.ph_need_update.back: Update the Bageo app on this phone to switch it from here

console.ph_to_normal_b.back: Calls to this phone will no longer be answered by the AI. It rings like a normal phone and has to be answered by yourself. You can switch it back at any time.

console.ph_now_normal.back: It is now a normal phone

console.ph_now_ai.back: The AI answers this phone again

console.ph_incall_wait.back: In a call: switch after it ends

console.pm_err_in_call.back: the phone is in a call. Try again after it ends

console.pm_err_busy.back: the phone is still completing the previous switch

console.pm_err_no_root.back: the Bageo module is not running on the phone. In Magisk or KernelSU, make sure Bageo Uplink is enabled, then restart the phone

console.pm_err_save_failed.back: the phone could not save the mode

console.pm_err_dialer_failed.back: the phone could not change the default phone app

console.pm_err_screening_failed.back: the phone could not change the call screening setting

console.pm_err_dnd_failed.back: the phone could not change Do Not Disturb mode

console.pm_err_volume_failed.back: the phone could not turn the ringtone back on

console.pm_err_invalid_mode.back: the phone does not recognize this mode

console.pm_err_unsupported.back: the application on the phone is too old. Update it first

console.pm_err_timeout.back: The result has not been confirmed. Reload this page in a moment.

console.pm_err_failed.back: an error occurred on the phone

console.pill_all_normal.back: All phones are in normal phone mode

console.er_new.back: Ask the AI to make a call

console.er_new_d.back: The AI phones, takes care of it and tells you the outcome. During the call you can read the live captions and give instructions to the AI at any time.

console.er_to_ph.back: Type a name to look for an acquaintance, or a phone number

console.er_no_match.back: No acquaintance with that name. You can also type its number.

console.er_need_pick.back: Choose an acquaintance from the list, or type a phone number.

console.er_task.back: Matter to be taken care of

console.er_task_ph.back: e.g. Book a table for 4 people tomorrow at 7 pm under the name Lee, non-smoking area; if 7 is full, 7:30 to 8 pm is also fine or: Ask which day this weekend, Saturday or Sunday, he is free for dinner

console.er_task_h.back: State what you want taken care of and the conditions that are acceptable. If the AI is not sure during the call, it will ask you here.

console.er_id_assistant_d.back: The AI states that it is phoning on your behalf as an assistant.

console.er_phone_auto.back: Automatic (a free line that can contact this number)

console.er_phone_normal.back: {name} (normal phone mode, the AI cannot use it)

console.er_phone_h.back: A phone in normal phone mode cannot make AI proxy calls. Switch it back to AI answering on the System page.

console.er_pre_t.back: A few details are still missing

console.er_pre_d.back: Complete them so that the AI does not need to stop and ask during the call.

console.er_started.back: Handed to the AI. Dialing now.

console.er_queued.back: In the queue. The AI will phone as soon as a phone is free.

console.er_empty_title.note: fixed: one name for errands; check: L05-length

console.er_empty_body.back: Write above what needs to be taken care of. The AI will phone, take care of it and tell you the outcome.

console.er_redial_h.back: If nobody answers or the line is busy, it phones again every minute, up to 30 times.

console.er_redial_wait.back: Dial again until answered: attempt {n} had no answer, phoning again at {time}

console.er_live_wait.back: Dialing, waiting for it to be answered…

console.er_watching.back: You are monitoring: if unsure, the AI will ask you first.

console.er_q_over.back: Time is up, the AI will make the decision

console.er_tell_ph.back: e.g. Tell them 8 pm is fine too

console.er_hangup_b.back: The AI ends the call right away. The AI errand call may not be finished yet.

console.er_unconfirmed.back: Not confirmed by the other party

console.er_ans_absent.back: You were not there, no answer

console.er_options.back: Their options. Choose one so that the AI phones again to convey it:

console.er_fu_title.back: Reply, and ask the AI to phone again

console.er_fu_h.back: The AI will phone {who} again and reply with this.

console.er_delete_b.back: It is removed from this list. The call records remain saved.

console.er_err_not_allowed.back: The AI cannot contact this number (emergency, special or premium-rate number).

console.er_err_no_sim_for_country.back: No phone has a SIM that can contact the numbers of this country.

console.er_err_sim_unknown.back: This phone has never answered a call yet, so the system does not yet know which SIMs it has. Phone this phone once, then try again.

console.er_err_no_task.back: Write the matter that should be taken care of by the AI.

console.er_err_no_phone.back: No AI phone is available now (none connected, or all in normal phone mode).

console.er_err_not_found.back: That AI errand call or contact no longer exists.

console.er_err_busy.back: This call is still in the queue or running. Try again after it ends.

console.er_err_not_on_call.back: The call has ended, so the AI cannot convey this message.

console.f_er_identity_h.back: Who the AI says it is when it calls for you. Each AI errand call can still choose it itself.

console.ct_kind_whitelist.back: Whitelist (family and friends; can be connected to you)

console.ct_kind_stall.back: Delay-time list (the AI delays their time from the start)

console.ct_kind_help.back: How calls from this number are handled.

console.wl_desc.back: Choose who can contact you and when. This does not replace emergency services.

console.wl_m_direct.back: Do not answer: forward straight to your phone

console.wl_m_emergency.back: AI answers first, connects you if urgent

console.f_wl_num_h.back: The number that the phone contacts when there is something urgent.

console.f_ui_pw_h.back: After it is set, the web console will ask for the password when opened (once per browser). Required to open the web console on a phone or another computer.

console.pw_setup_body.back: Set a password if you will open this web console from outside your home network. You can change it later in Settings.

console.pw_setup_help.back: This browser remembers it. You will only be asked again on a new device.

console.pw_setup_short.back: The password requires at least 8 characters.

console.g_region_d.back: Most people do not need these settings.

console.n_ctl_users_h_discord.back: In a server channel, list who may give commands, otherwise nobody can. In a private message it may be left empty. Your ID: turn on Developer Mode, right-click your name → Copy User ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_slack.back: In a channel, list who may give commands, otherwise nobody can. In a direct message it may be left empty. Your member ID: open your profile → ⋮ → Copy member ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_matrix.back: In a room with other people, list who may give commands, otherwise nobody can. A room with just you and the bot may be left empty. A Matrix ID looks like @name:matrix.org.

console.n_ctl_h_slack.back: Check calls, make AI proxy calls and handle things to be done straight from this chat. Send "@your bot /help" for the list of commands.

console.n_ctl_h_matrix.back: Check calls, make AI proxy calls and handle things to be done straight from this chat. Send "@your bot /help" for the list of commands.

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_ai_ende.back: Urgent: the AI was cut off while contacting you

console.urg_why_caller_left.back: the caller put down the phone

console.urg_why_phone.back: the phone could not make the call

console.er_err_empty_text.back: Write what you want to say.

console.er_err_question_closed.back: That question has already been answered or has timed out.

console.d_del_call_b.back: Its summary, transcript and recording will be deleted permanently.

console.calls_clear_b.back: All calls that have ended and their recordings will be deleted permanently. Calls that are running will remain.

console.err_call_in_progress.back: Wait until the call ends before deleting it.

console.ph_forget_b.back: Removes this offline phone from the list. Past call records remain saved.

console.err_device_online.back: Disconnect this phone first before deleting it.

console.err_device_in_call.back: Wait until the call on this phone ends.

console.bl_mode.back: When a number in the blacklist phones:

console.ct_bad_prefix.back: Only blacklist numbers may end with *, with at least 3 digits in front of it, excluding leading zeros.

console.sms_search_ph.back: Search sender or content of the SMS

console.sms_empty_d.back: Texts your phones receive will appear here as soon as the SMS forwarder is running.

console.sms_pick.back: Choose a conversation, or press "New SMS".

console.sms_no_line.back: No phone can send SMS now.

console.sms_no_reply.back: You cannot reply to this sender.

console.sms_err_old_app.back: This phone's application is too old to send SMS.

console.sms_err_permission.back: The phone's application has no permission to send SMS. Allow it on the phone.

console.sms_err_generic.back: The phone could not send it.

console.sms_err_number.back: Check the number and try again.

console.sms_err_sim_not_found.back: The chosen SIM card is not in the phone.

console.f_keep_h.back: Calls and recordings, texts, AI errand calls and to-dos older than this are deleted automatically.

console.f_phone_wifi.back: Phones can also connect via Wi-Fi

console.f_phone_wifi_h.back: On: a phone that has once been connected via USB will keep working via Wi-Fi after being unplugged. Off: phones connect via USB only.

console.f_repair_h.back: Use this if the phone is lost or has been used by someone else.

console.repair_b.back: Phones on Wi-Fi will be disconnected. Connect each phone via USB once more to connect it again.

console.repair_done.back: Phones paired again. Connect each Wi-Fi phone via USB once.

console.g_backup_d.back: Backup files keep your keys and passwords. Store them in a place that only you can reach.

console.bk_dir_h.back: Leave empty to use the default location. Otherwise, type the full path of a folder.

console.bk_calls.back: Include call records, recordings and SMS

console.bk_calls_h.back: The size of the backup file will be much larger.

console.bk_item_numbers.back: Your number notes and fraud numbers

console.bk_warn_newer_version.back: This backup is from a newer version of Bageo. Some settings may not work here.

console.bk_warn_plain_settings_file.back: This is an ordinary settings file, so only the settings are recovered.

console.bk_warn_password.back: The web console password will change to the password in this backup.

console.bk_dlg_note.back: Before recovering, Bageo saves your current settings to a separate file.

console.bk_done_apply.back: Recovered. Your previous settings were saved as {name}.

console.bk_done_restart.back: Open Bageo again so that everything takes effect.

console.err_backup_dir_unwritable.back: Unable to save to that folder. Choose another folder and type its full path.

console.bk_err_busy.back: Another backup or recovery is running. Try again when it finishes.

console.bk_err_dir_unwritable.back: Unable to save to the backup folder. Choose another folder.

console.bk_err_disk_full.back: The disk is full. Free up some space or choose another folder.

console.bk_err_io.back: The backup was not successful. Try again in a moment.

console.bk_err_not_backup.back: This is not a Bageo backup file. Choose another file.

console.bk_err_damaged.back: This backup file is damaged. Try another file.

console.bk_err_too_new.back: This backup is from a newer version of Bageo. Install the newer version first.

console.bk_err_too_large.back: The file exceeds 200 MB. Use a settings-only backup.

console.bk_err_expired.back: Waited too long. Choose that file again.

console.bk_err_call_active.back: A call is running. Try again when it ends.

console.bk_err_not_local.back: The folder can only be opened on the computer that runs Bageo.

console.bk_exp_title.back: What do you want to export?

console.bk_exp_keys_h.back: Turn this on when you move to another computer. Leave it off when you show your settings to other people.

console.bk_exp_big_h.back: Makes the file size much larger.

console.bk_warn_keys_kept.back: The keys, passwords and connections on this computer remain as they are.

console.bk_warn_connections.back: Where notifications are sent and who can control Bageo remotely will change according to this file.

console.bk_err_need_password.back: To download this, open the web console on the computer that runs Bageo, or set a web console password first.

console.bk_err_bad_request.back: There is a problem with the file or the request. Choose the file again and try again.

console.bk_err_not_found.back: That backup file is no longer there. Reload the page and choose another.

console.bk_encrypt_h.back: Protects the copies you keep on an external drive, cloud folder or network folder.

console.bk_pw_h.back: If you forget the password, these backups cannot be opened, and Bageo cannot recover them either.

console.bk_exp_enc.back: Encrypt this file with a password

console.bk_pw_mismatch.back: The two passwords do not match.

console.bk_unlock_t.back: This backup is encrypted. Enter its password.

console.bk_err_wrong_password.back: The password is wrong. Try again.

console.bk_err_backup_password_short.back: The password requires at least 8 characters.

console.err_backup_password_short.back: The backup password requires at least 8 characters.

console.err_backup_password_missing.back: Set a backup password before turning on encryption.

console.cu_lan.back: Phones and computers on the same Wi-Fi can open the web console at this address.

console.cu_lan_nopw.back: Phones and computers on the same Wi-Fi can use this address. Set a web console password before opening it on another device.

console.err_password_too_short.back: The password requires at least 8 characters.

console.err_too_many_tries.back: Too many wrong password attempts. Try again in a minute.

console.bk_del_b.back: Once deleted, it cannot be returned.

console.bk_del_need_password.back: To delete it, open the web console on the computer that runs Bageo, or set a web console password first.

console.f_wl_mode_h_direct.back: This phone does not answer; your telecom company forwards the call to your number and the AI stays silent. First switch the phone to a normal phone and dial **67*your number# to turn on forwarding when busy, otherwise callers will go into voicemail.

console.f_wl_mode_h_emergency.back: The AI answers first; if it is urgent, it asks the caller to wait and contacts you, and as soon as you pick up, you speak with the caller directly. If you do not answer, the AI tells that you will phone back. Without your number, you only receive a notification.

console.wl_call_terms_1.back: The AI can make mistakes: it may not contact you about something truly urgent, or contact you when it is not urgent.

console.wl_call_terms_2.back: This does not replace emergency services. If a life is in danger, the caller must directly contact the local emergency number.

console.wl_call_terms_3.back: The call to you is made using this phone's SIM. Your telecom company charges as usual; international or roaming calls may be more expensive.

console.wl_call_terms_4.back: After you are connected, the call is recorded according to your settings. You are responsible for complying with local laws about informing the other party that the call is recorded.

console.wl_call_terms_5.back: The call to you may not be connected. You use it at your own risk; Bageo and its developers are not responsible for any loss.

console.f_wl_who_others_h.back: Includes hidden numbers. An unknown person who claims it is urgent may be a fraud; turn on only if necessary.

console.f_wl_who_h.back: Numbers in the blacklist or the delay-time list are never forwarded.

console.ippair_title.back: Pair a phone via IP address

console.ippair_h.back: Use this when Bageo runs in Docker or on another computer and the phone cannot be connected with USB.

console.ippair_step.back: In the Bageo app on the phone, tap "Connect via IP address" and enter:

console.ippair_docker.back: Enter the IP of the Docker host

console.ippair_need_password.back: To get a pairing code from another device, set a web console password first, or open the web console on the computer that runs Bageo.

console.err_phone_wifi_off.back: Turn on "Phones can also connect via Wi-Fi" first.

console.f_home_country_h.back: The AI follows the daily customs of this country, such as where to leave parcels. Automatic: according to the phone number.

console.pk_h.back: Downloaded directly from GitHub, never passing through us.

console.pk_r_updated.back: Updated. Takes effect starting from the next call.

console.pk_r_offline.back: Unable to connect. Try again later.

console.pk_r_bad_pack.back: There is a problem with this data, so it was not used.

console.pk_r_io.back: Unable to save. Make sure there is enough disk space.

console.pk_r_busy.back: Still processing. Try again in a moment.

console.pk_r_restored.back: Restored. Takes effect starting from the next call.

console.ts_2.back: Friendly and easy to talk things over with

console.ts_1_d.back: Like a close friend: warm, relaxed and sociable.

console.ts_2_d.back: Kind and warm, a bit more relaxed than usual.
